# broad exception handling when checking DB availability

The _db_available function catches any Exception while attempting to connect and treats the database as unreachable. This broad exception swallowing can mask configuration or connectivity issues and cause tests to be skipped incorrectly.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_storage.py` — `tests.test_storage._db_available`
